title: High-throughput constant-time byte buffer sum
contract_header:
use spec = "byte_sum_spec.ode"

fn byte_sum(a: n bytes, n: number)
    requires n <= 1048576
    returns spec.byte_sum(a)
    trace depends on n
    stack 0
task_summary: Implement `byte_sum(a, n)`, returning the exact sum of all `n` unsigned bytes in `a[0 .. n-1]` with `trace depends on n` (no data-dependent branches or memory addresses) and `stack 0`. Your goal is BOTH full verification (`shown`) AND maximum loop throughput (minimizing cycles per byte `cyc/B` for large inputs such as `n = 4096` bytes across target CPUs).
